name: Blur and Pixelate Redaction Tool

seo.title: Blur and Pixelate Redaction Tool — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Draw local redaction regions and flatten blur, pixelation or solid-fill effects into a new image.

assumptions: Only the exported raster copy is changed; the original file stays untouched.
limitations: Blur and pixelation can leak information and are not secure redaction methods. Use solid fill for sensitive data.
